messages:
chloe-partners: Heads-up: we're planning a breaking change for Partner API: deprecate v2 list endpoints and introduce v3 with a small shape change: top-level `items` -> `records` and `meta.total` -> `total_count`. This affects marketplace adapters + SDK list helpers. Need rollout plan and partner comms. (2399000001)
tom-engineering: Can you enumerate urgent consumers? Marketplace indexer, JS/py SDK list helpers, and a few SIs that page through list endpoints.
chloe-partners: Known consumers: marketplace catalog sync, SI C (retail), SI D (analytics), internal integrators. Unknown: some older marketplace vendors using direct polling.
megan-ps: GTM ask: 60 days minimum notice for breaking API for marketplace partners. Also prefer a soft-deprecation window where both fields are present.
lily-qa: QA: we need dual-shape fixtures + contract tests. Also need a canary that returns both shapes for 30 days, then 100% v3 after 60 days.
tom-engineering: Proposed approach: 1) v3 endpoint returns `records` and `total_count`. 2) For the deprecation window, v2 will continue to return `items` and `meta.total`. 3) Add `X-Redwood-API-Version` response header and deprecation warnings in `meta.deprecation`. Also add `compat=true` query param to opt-in to dual-shape on v3 for earlier testing.
sam-legal: Check whether any SLA/contract language references the exact JSON fields. If so we need legal notification. Otherwise we can proceed with standard deprecation notice.
chloe-partners: I'll prepare partner notice draft. Megan: can you coordinate marketplace vendor list and preferred contact points?
megan-ps: Will assemble vendor list tomorrow. Proposed comms cadence: Day 0 private notice to impacted vendors + SIs, Day 7 SDK patch (parsers accept both), Day 14 public deprecation blog, Day 30 start optional dual-shape canary, Day 60 switch to v3-only.
vish-ops: Canary plan: route 2% of marketplace sync traffic to canary returns (compat mode) for 14 days, run schema diff checks, promote to 20% if stable. We'll export metric `partner.api.list.shape_mismatch` and alert if >0.5% for 1h.
lily-qa: Test matrix for SDKs: - tolerant deserialization (records or items), - pagination helpers accept both `total_count` and `meta.total`, - roundtrip examples, - CI gating. Add RW ticket RW-1201.
tom-engineering: Code snippet for tolerant parsing we'll add to SDK release notes:
```js
// tolerant list parser (JS)
function extractList(resp) {
  const body = resp.body || {};
  const records = body.records || body.items || [];
  const total = body.total_count ?? (body.meta && body.meta.total) ?? records.length;
  return { records, total };
}
```
megan-ps: Partner action item: ask vendors to run a nightly smoke against a compat endpoint we expose and share results. That lets us catch strict validators.
sam-legal: For marketplace vendors, include rollback window and support SLA in the notice. Legal will pre-approve template; cc me on first batch.
chloe-partners: Owners: Chloe (partner notices), Tom (engineering rollout), Lily (QA), Megan (vendor outreach), Sam (legal). Deliverables & deadlines: 1) partner private notice draft by EOD +1 (2399000120), 2) SDK patches with tolerant parsing by EOD +10 (2399004320), 3) canary config ready by +14, 4) v3-only enforcement +60.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: list-v3-compat-canary -> canary cluster at 2026-06-12T02:00Z (build #4715) :rocket: (event ts 2399000155)
tom-engineering: We'll also add a feature-flag `enable_v3_strict` on marketplace ingestion adapter so vendors can opt in early. Will add metric `partner.api.v3.opt_in.count`.
lily-qa: Running preliminary contract tests locally; found one vendor parser that assumes `meta` always present and crashes. Marked vendor as high-touch.
megan-ps: On high-touch vendor: I'll schedule a pairing session to walk them through tolerant parsing and provide a temporary shim.
chloe-partners: Suggest including example migration snippet in all SDKs and a migration checklist: 1) update parsing, 2) validate counts, 3) run compat tests, 4) opt into canary.
tom-engineering: Also, we can ship a shimming proxy for vendors that cannot change quickly. But it's limited-run; recommend only for top 5 vendors.
sam-legal: Approve shimming proxy for contracted vendors under emergency support, legal to sign short addendum.
megan-ps: I'll add an opt-in form in the partner portal to request shims or early access. That will help triage.
lily-qa: QA will publish a compatibility dashboard: per-vendor pass/fail and parsing error rates. We'll surface it to partnerships and GTM daily.
deploy-bot: canary started: list-v3-compat-canary -> 2% traffic (2026-06-12T02:03Z) :white_check_mark: (event ts 2399000200)
tom-engineering: Early telemetry: mismatch metric at 0.12% overall; high-touch vendor accounts for 0.09% of that. Rolling a quick SDK patch + vendor shim for them.
chloe-partners: Nice. Keep updates here. I'll circulate the private notice once SDKs with tolerant parsers are published. Thanks everyone.
